text: Cross-File Security Correlator upgrades severity by one level only when a confirmed taint chain crosses at least one crossComponent:true hop in the Link Graph; intra-component chains retain the original severity from the Security findings

Cross-File Security Correlator confirms chain-002 from telemetry_consumer.py: bus.subscribe() being unresolved in the Link Graph does not prevent chain confirmation when the consume()->handle()->yaml.load() data flow is fully traceable within the delivered source — only the producer side is unknown

When no callers of a vulnerable function (export_report, region_for, load_quota_profile) exist in the delivered source tree, the Cross-File Security Correlator records a partial chain with stoppedAt=function-entry and a gap note directing humans to find call sites in missing components (Django views, URL routing)

When the Link Graph resolves a previously open-end seam as crossComponent:true in a later run, the Cross-File Security Correlator re-evaluates all chains touching that seam and upgrades severity by one level if the chain now crosses the confirmed boundary — document the upgrade with revisionNote and severityUpgradeReason fields in the chain record

aurora-compute and aurora-portal both land under src/payload_plaintext/ so seam_index component_of() yields 'payload_plaintext' for both — the tool cannot detect cross-service seams within this subdirectory; the secondary pass must catch them via literal matching (2026-10-08)
